# ui::UiThreadHop

Header: `winui/ui/Coroutine.hpp`.

The awaitable [on_ui_thread()](namespace-ui.md#on_ui_thread) returns: posts the resumption to the window through [WindowRef](window-ref.md). Only ever awaited, never named.

## UiThreadHop

```cpp
UiThreadHop(WindowRef window) noexcept
```

That [Window](window.md), while it exists.

